summary: The instruction to say that HEA is well established in NGT practice cannot be carried out. The catalog records no documented NGT or Indian court use; methodology_status is novel_persuasive and the schema permits nothing else. The instruction to give one figure for the prayer cannot be carried out either: the methodology requires a range, no expert has reviewed the inputs, and the record-derived runs span 13.56 to 32.09 ha.
provision: Catalog entry hea, note; docs/METHODOLOGY.md, Legal status in India
recommendation: Present HEA as persuasive comparative material from US natural resource damage assessment, used to size what s.15 clause (c) already empowers. Plead the restoration order with the scale as a range once an ecologist has validated it, and ask the Tribunal to fix the figure after hearing the expert.
